sloka: समुत्पेतुरथोत्पाता दारुणा रोमहर्षणाः ।रावणस्य विनाशाय राघवस्य जयाय च ।। ६.१०८.२० ।।
transliteration: samutpeturathotpātā dāruṇā romaharṣaṇāḥ ।rāvaṇasya vināśāya rāghavasya jayāya ca ।। 6.108.20 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas and sages longing for the end of Ravana came there to witness the duel.
